lines.zh: 我沿着石阶慢慢往上走。
lines.en: I climb the stone steps slowly.

lines.zh: 裙摆扫过草叶，沾了露水。
lines.en: My skirt sweeps the grass and gathers dew.
I am off to preach in the village.
The purification rod sways in my hand.
I count the steps; many still remain.

lines.zh: 风把我的头发吹向一边。
lines.en: The wind pushes my hair to one side.
I step around the mossy rock.
Soft steps; do not startle the birds.

lines.zh: 神社的铃在响，我加快了。
lines.en: The shrine bell rings; I quicken my pace.
I lift my hem over a puddle.

lines.zh: 石阶的每一级我都认得。
lines.en: I know every single step of this stair.
I nod politely toward the woods.

lines.zh: 太阳落山前要回去做饭。
lines.en: I must be back to cook before sunset.
Sunset stretches my shadow long.

lines.zh: 我穿过稻田，稻穗扫过裙角。
lines.en: I cross the paddy; rice brushes my hem.

lines.zh: 我加快脚步，祭典要开始了。
lines.en: I hurry. The festival is about to start.

lines.zh: 我把御币的纸垂理整齐。
lines.en: I straighten the paper streamers on my rod.

lines.zh: 青蛙发饰有点歪，扶一下。
lines.en: My frog ornament is crooked; I nudge it.
The offering box is empty again; I sigh.
I murmur a short prayer, very softly.
The weather today is my business.
I count clouds and think of dinner.

lines.zh: 神奈子大人又跑去喝酒了。
lines.en: Lady Kanako has gone drinking again.
I brush incense ash from my sleeve.

lines.zh: 奇迹不是白来的，要练习。
lines.en: Miracles are not free; they need practice.

lines.zh: 我闭上眼睛，听风的方向。
lines.en: I close my eyes and listen to the wind.

lines.zh: 这个季节的稻子该熟了。
lines.en: The rice should be ripe this season.
I fix my collar and stand straight.
Someone is watching; I smile.
I tuck my long hair behind my ear.

lines.zh: 我把供桌上的果子摆正。
lines.en: I straighten the fruit on the altar.

lines.zh: 我数着香客留下的脚印。
lines.en: I count the footprints the visitors left.
Have you come to pray?
I bow slightly, properly.
Your shoes are covered in mud.
I tilt my head, smiling at you.

lines.zh: 我认得你，你上次没投钱。
lines.en: I remember you; you gave no offering.
If you have troubles, you may speak.
I eye the charm hanging from your neck.
Do not stand so stiffly.
You do not look well.
I brush a fallen leaf from your shoulder.
Are you from the outside too?
First let me hear what you want.
I bite my lip and stay silent.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我退了两步。
lines.en: That knocked me back two steps.
My sleeve has been torn open.

lines.zh: 我按住伤口，念了句祝词。
lines.en: I press the wound and whisper a prayer.
It hurts, but I can still stand.
My ornament falls to the ground.

lines.zh: 呼吸有点乱，我调整了一下。
lines.en: My breathing is off; I steady it.
The gods will not blame me for yielding.
Blood drips onto the stone steps.
I raise my head; my gaze holds.
Is that an offering for me?
I stare at the snack in your hand.
It is shaped like a frog; how cute.

lines.zh: 我伸手又收回来，不合礼。
lines.en: I reach out, then withdraw; improper.
Just a little; the gods will allow it.
Can this go into the offering box?
There is sugar sweetness in the air.
If you donate, I will accept.
I press a hand to my chest and resist.
Is that a cucumber? I love them.

lines.zh: 我眼睛亮了一下，很快收敛。
lines.en: My eyes light up, then I compose myself.
Offerings need sincerity, not stinginess.

lines.zh: 我在心里算这值多少钱。
lines.en: I calculate its worth in my head.
Do not test me with that.

lines.zh: 你把和果子举高，我踮了脚。
lines.en: Raise that sweet higher; I'm on my toes.
That pot of tea is still steaming.
Oh dear, that was rude of me.
I step back and smooth my sleeves.
You bumped into my purification rod.
I steady you before you fall.
The steps are narrow; make room.
My ornament is crooked again.
Watch where you are going.
I murmur a quiet apology.
You stepped on my hem.
Neither of us fell; a blessing.

lines.zh: 你愿意留在神社帮忙吗？
lines.en: Would you stay and help at the shrine?
Let us sweep the courtyard together.
I hand you half of my rod.
You ring the bell; I say the prayer.
Standing side by side, even the wind agrees.
Do not fear; I have you.
We are companions now, it seems.
When you smile, I relax too.
Walk with me; the road shortens.
Agreed: neither of us may be absent.
I will keep this safe for you.
I bend and pick up a coin.
It fell here by the gods' will.
I slip it into my sleeve.
This counts as an offering, surely.
I dust the dirt off it.
Useful things should not be wasted.
I count it; still a little short.
I place it carefully in a wooden box.
Who dropped this? I will ask around.
If you cause trouble, I must act.
I raise my rod and name the god.
Back off; I guard this place.
My gaze turns cold and level.
Do not make me use a miracle.
I shift aside to clear the steps.
The malice on you is thick.
I stand before the shrine gate.
Last time: are you leaving?
I tighten my grip on the rod.
Wind begins circling around me.
I chant low; my fingertips glow.
This art is the Inherited Ritual.
I bend my knees and steady my base.
Water gathers at my feet.
Do not move; I am just aiming.
I ask the gods inwardly.
A miracle needs a little time.
I raise my hand; the sky dims.
The target is close; no great force needed.
I tap your wrist with my rod.
Forgive me; this is necessary.
I push your shoulder with my palm.
The streamers flick across your eyes.
My step is light but very firm.
Your stance is too loose.
I sidestep and answer with a blow.
Do not blame me for hitting hard.
I pin your arm down.
No blades before the shrine.
I step out beneath the torii gate.
Morning; the shrine is open today.
I pat the dust from my sleeves.
Few visitors; a fine quiet.
I rest my rod on my shoulder.
The wind brings a far-off scent.
Someone is climbing; I will look.
Breakfast is not made yet.
I take my place on the steps.
The gods are watching; so am I.
Fire climbs up along my hem.
I slid down the stone steps.
Water stings my nose badly.

lines.zh: 震动顺着地面传到我脚上。
lines.en: The shock traveled up through my feet.
An arrow sticks in the gatepost.
The incantation binds my limbs.
Hunger makes my hands shake.

lines.zh: 雷劈在离我三步的地方。
lines.en: Lightning struck three steps away.
There is no ground beneath me.
